canonical.title: A Michelin Weekend in Beijing: Dinner, the Wall, and the Forbidden City

sources.title: Palace Museum (Forbidden City) — Official Site
sources.claim: 40,000-ticket daily cap, releases 7 days ahead at 20:00 BJT

sources.title: Xin Rong Ji — Michelin Guide
sources.claim: 3-star; 28-day-old Peking duck requires advance pre-order; tasting menu ¥1,850–2,580 + 15% service

sources.title: Lamdre — Asia's 50 Best Restaurants 2026, #17
sources.claim: Lamdre ranked #17 at Asia's 50 Best 2026, Highest Climber Award (+33 places)

sources.title: Lamdre — The Beijinger
sources.claim: Only Beijing entry in Asia's 50 Best 2026; bookable in English on Resy

sources.title: King's Joy — Michelin Guide
sources.claim: 2-star vegetarian restaurant in a courtyard beside Lama Temple; tasting menus ¥999–3,999

sources.title: Mutianyu Great Wall — Official Site
sources.claim: Recommended first-timer section; 60–70% fewer crowds than Badaling; 65 km from city

sources.title: Blackswan — Michelin Guide
sources.claim: 2-star French contemporary in Luohong Art Museum, Shunyi, near Capital Airport

sources.title: Michelin Guide Beijing 2026 — Official Announcement
sources.claim: 2026 guide: 2 three-star, 6 two-star restaurants; Blackswan and Lamdre promoted to ★★

sources.title: How to Book Forbidden City Tickets — China Discovery
sources.claim: Tickets released 7 days ahead at 20:00 BJT; real-name with passport; no same-day sales

sources.title: Tiananmen Square Reservation Guide 2026 — Real China Trip
sources.claim: Book by 22:00 the night before via WeChat mini-program; use Qianmen South Gate

sources.title: Mutianyu Great Wall — Travel China Guide
sources.claim: Entrance ¥40; cable car + toboggan ¥200; 65 km / 90 min from city

sources.title: Mutianyu Toboggan — Wild Great Wall
sources.claim: 1,580 m track, 260 m vertical drop, fast lane up to 40 km/h

sources.title: Jingshan Park — China Highlights
sources.claim: 45 m artificial Ming-dynasty hill; Wanchun Pavilion offers best Forbidden City panorama

sources.title: Blackswan — Gastronomap
sources.claim: Harmony 6-course ¥1,680; Freedom 3-course ¥1,080; 89 Capital Airport Road, Shunyi
